# docker_buildx_history_records (Data Source)

Lists the build records of a buildx builder, like `docker buildx history ls`: ref, name, status, start time and duration of each build, newest first. Records come from BuildKit's build history API on the builder's running nodes.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "docker_buildx_history_records" "recent" {
  builder = "default"
  limit   = 10
}

output "recent_builds" {
  value = [for r in data.docker_buildx_history_records.recent.records : "${r.name} ${r.status} ${r.duration}"]
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `builder` (String) Builder whose records are read (`--builder`). Default `default`, the daemon's built-in BuildKit; other names are docker-container builders on the provider's daemon (see `docker_buildx_builder`).
- `limit` (Number) Maximum number of records, newest first. Default: all.

### Read-Only

- `buildx_version` (String) The buildx release whose output format and semantics this type mirrors (pin v0.38.2); not a runtime binary, the provider never runs buildx.
- `content_sha256` (String) SHA-256 of history_json, to detect drift without diffing the document.
- `history_json` (String) Build records of the builder as one JSON array (the `history ls --format json` view).
- `records` (Attributes List) One entry per build record. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--records))
- `refs` (List of String) Build record refs, newest first; each is a valid `ref` for `docker_buildx_history`.

<a id="nestedatt--records"></a>
### Nested Schema for `records`

Read-Only:

- `created_at` (String) Upstream `CreatedAt`.
- `duration` (String) Upstream `Duration`.
- `id` (String) Upstream `ID`.
- `name` (String) Upstream `Name`.
- `status` (String) Upstream `Status`.
